task_description:
Use the right arm to separate the six nested upside-down paper cups and stack them into a 3-2-1 pyramid structure.
Success condition: All six cups are correctly stacked in the pyramid structure.
substages: 1. move right arm to a paper cup
2. grasp paper cup
3. move paper cup to the empty space of the table
4. release the paper cup
5. repeat the above steps
6. move right arm to align with a cup
7. grasp cup
8. move cup to correct position
9. release cup in that position
10. repeat until all cupss are placed into a 3-2-1 pyramid structure
label: failure

task_description: Place all six balls into the six slots egg carton: use the right arm to place every ball lying to the right of the carton, then use the left arm to place the balls lying on its left. Success condition: The right-side balls are all placed before the left arm starts, and all six balls end up seated one per slot in the six slots egg carton, with no ball left on the table.
substages: 1. move right arm to a right-side ball
2. grasp right-side ball
3. move right-side ball above a free egg carton cup
4. release right-side ball into cup
5. repeat for all right-side balls
6. move left arm to a left-side ball
7. grasp left-side ball
8. move left-side ball above a free egg carton cup
9. release left-side ball into cup
10. repeat for all left-side balls
label: failure

8. release small block

task_description: Hand the three items across the central partition: the arm on the item side picks up each object and passes it to the other arm in mid-air above the partition, and the receiving arm places it into the container on its own side. Success condition: All three items are passed arm-to-arm across the partition and end up in the container.
substages: 1. move passer arm to an item on the object side
2. grasp the item
3. lift the item into mid-air above the barrier
4. move receiver arm across to the held item
5. grasp the item with the receiver arm
6. release the item from the passer arm
7. move the item above the receptacle on the receiver side
8. release the item into the receptacle
9. repeat for all three items
label: failure
